fieldDescription: Adds a Fast survey option to unsurveyed planets with no colony. One click pays the survey cost and runs the full survey, then shows what was found right in the planet dialog, with any ruins ready to explore.
Closes the planet dialog after a fast survey when the planet has no unexplored ruins. The survey results go to the message log instead.
Goes straight from a debris field to the salvage cost screen, without the Assess step.
Goes straight from a derelict, station or cache to the salvage cost screen, without the Explore step. Never skipped when automated defenses guard it, so you can still leave before the fight.
When a salvage accident costs crew or heavy machinery, the loot screen opens right away instead of stopping on the damage report. The losses go to the message log.

fieldName: Skip Continue after a salvage find
fieldDescription: When a derelict holds a find that asks nothing of you (survey data, a blueprint, a hint about another wreck, some cargo), goes straight on to the salvage cost screen. The find stays in the dialog text. Finds with a choice keep it.
After you beat the automated defenses of a derelict, goes straight on instead of stopping on a screen with only Continue.

fieldName: Leftover debris goes into the loot
fieldDescription: Salvaging a station, probe, cache or other derelict normally leaves a debris field to scavenge afterwards. With this on, that debris is picked over in the same operation: its loot and experience join the first loot screen and no debris field is left behind.

Opening floating cargo pods shows their contents right away, without the Examine pod contents step. Locked pods are not affected. After you close the contents, the usual options (such as putting the pods into a stable orbit) are there.

Continue on the ship recovery screen opens the loot screen right away, instead of stopping on a screen with only Pick through the wreckage. Needs the PatchLib mod. Credits found in the wreckage go to the message log.
